scope:
Replay all examples and independently re-evaluate Timber against archived vectors.

No new source downloads, no live runtime mutation and no change to science settings.
The fresh evaluation uses finite radar candidate/score support. The historical
receipt used common radar/optical support; these denominators are NOT interchangeable.

replay.scope:
Isolated seven-example API/restart release gate; never uses the live runtime.

Runs guided and editable recipes, checks exact original rasters/metrics, every
saved preview, opening PNG/scale, My Tools export/reopen, and restart recovery.
Protected inputs and tutorial assets are read-only. This is engineering replay,
not independent scientific accuracy, a browser task study or a peak-RAM quota.

P03_Timber_Fire.protocol: All common finite fire_score/fire_candidate radar cells; archived vectors rasterized by cell centre on the actual exported grid. AUC independently computed by average-rank Mann–Whitney statistic, including ties.
P03_Timber_Fire.historical_protocol: Earlier published app statistics use common radar/optical support; the optical pixel support is not bundled as a numerical mask, so its AUC is not presented as freshly recomputed.

reference_independence.official_perimeter: External operational incident boundary, a proxy that can contain unburned islands; not field-level burn truth.
reference_independence.author_output: Author-derived result using the same NISAR observations; agreement measures reproduction rather than independent accuracy.
